# Multica for Android (unofficial) 2.1.0

Unofficial Android client for Multica. Supported server: Multica v0.6.1 (self-hosted).

Update from 2.0.0: install the APK over the existing app. It keeps your server, sign-in and settings (same signing key, versionCode 3).

## Highlights

- **Tables in the chat without clipping.** Markdown tables are drawn as a wrapping grid or as cards, with a full view that follows rotation. TalkBack reads them row by row.
- **Replies as in the web app.** A Reply button under every thread, a reply target that stays with the draft, and a preview of which agents a comment starts. Deselect an agent to keep it from starting.
- **Faster @-mentions.** Pick several people, agents or issues as chips and confirm with "Done". A "Frequent" section shows whom you mention most. The suggestion bar stays above the keyboard.
- **Hide people and agents** on this device, so they leave lists, pickers and filters.
- **Title filter.** A regular expression hides matching issues in the lists and on the board. Push notifications for them can be muted.
- **Agent view with Chat and New issue.** Start a chat with an agent or create an issue for it directly from its detail screen.

## Fixes

- After the @-sheet the cursor returns to the input, so typed text is not lost.
- Larger touch targets for removing chips and attachments in the composer.

## Known issues

See [KNOWN_ISSUES.md](https://github.com/1270011/multica-android-unofficial/blob/main/KNOWN_ISSUES.md), for example: the @-sheet in the chat tab stays empty until you type a search text, and a few TalkBack announcements still contain Markdown characters.

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/1270011/multica-android-unofficial/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Download

`multica-unofficial-2.1.0.apk` (ARM, Android 7.0 or newer). Check the SHA-256 checksum in `multica-unofficial-2.1.0.apk.sha256` before installing.
